privacyModal.title: Privacy Policy
privacyModal.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Berg See Home ("we", "us") collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you use our website and booking services.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: When you make a booking or contact us, we collect information such as your name, email address, phone number, postal address, country, and payment details necessary to process your reservation.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use your information to process bookings, communicate with you about your stay, handle payments, and comply with legal obligations such as local guest registration requirements.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.body: We retain your booking and guest data for as long as necessary to fulfil your stay. After your check-out date, we keep your data for one month, after which it is permanently deleted from our systems.

sections.heading: Payment Information
sections.body: Payments are processed securely by our payment provider (Stripe). We do not store your full card details on our servers.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: We use cookies to remember your language and currency preferences. You can manage your cookie preferences at any time.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data. To exercise these rights, please contact us using the details below.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us via the contact details provided on this website.

termsModal.title: Terms and Conditions
termsModal.intro: These Terms and Conditions govern your booking and your stay at Berg See Home. By making a reservation through this website, you agree to the terms set out below.

sections.heading: Booking and Confirmation
sections.body: A reservation is confirmed once we have received your booking request and the required payment has been processed successfully. You will then receive a confirmation email containing the details of your stay.

sections.heading: Prices and Payment
sections.body: All prices are shown per night in the currency you select and include applicable taxes unless stated otherwise. Payment is processed securely by our payment provider at the time of booking. Additional local charges, such as a tourist tax, may apply and will be indicated before you confirm.

sections.heading: Cancellations and Refunds
sections.body: The cancellation policy that applies to your reservation is shown before you confirm the booking and repeated in your confirmation email. Refunds are calculated according to that policy and returned to the original payment method.

sections.heading: Check-in and Check-out
sections.body: Check-in and check-out times are stated in your booking confirmation. Please let us know in advance if you expect to arrive outside the agreed window so that we can arrange access.

sections.heading: Occupancy and Guests
sections.body: The apartment may only be occupied by the number of guests stated in the reservation. Additional visitors, as well as subletting or commercial use of the apartment, require our prior written consent.

sections.heading: House Rules
sections.body: We ask you to treat the apartment and its furnishings with care, to respect quiet hours, and to observe the no-smoking rule inside the property. Pets are permitted only where this has been agreed in advance.

sections.heading: Damages and Liability
sections.body: You are responsible for any damage caused during your stay beyond normal wear and tear, and we ask you to report it to us promptly. We are not liable for loss of or damage to guests' personal belongings, except where caused by our own fault.

sections.heading: Governing Law
sections.body: These Terms are governed by the law of the country in which the property is located. Should any provision be invalid, the remaining provisions remain in full effect.

amenities.subtitle: Everything included in your stay at Berg See Home
amenities.description: This spacious apartment is comprised of 1 living room, 2 separate bedrooms and 1 bathroom with a bath and free toiletries. The fully equipped kitchen features a refrigerator, a dishwasher, kitchenware and a microwave. Featuring a balcony with lake views, this apartment also offers a tea and coffee maker and a flat-screen TV. The unit offers 5 beds.
